author: for_N5R1
text:
opencode fixed a remote code execution bug on sep 28, 2026, in version 1.18.33. the release notes called it a browser opener refactor. no advisory, no cve, no mention that it was security at all.

the chain is short. a remote mcp server hands the client an oauth https://t.co/WvmB48NjUo

author: selvakumartp
text:
Your AI tool's supplier's supplier got hacked.

Fireworks AI says a breached cloud host led to access to some customer datasets and secrets. Notion was hit too.

Never paste passwords or keys into AI. Rotate keys on a calendar.

Know your vendor chain?

#AI #CyberSecurity

author: chris_uk2026
text: Microsoft #PatchTuesday: ~1,094 fixes (63 Critical). Actively exploited Outlook zero-day CVE-2026-124194 leaks NTLM hashes. Also zero-click RCEs in Search/Exchange & LDAP (9.8).

author: BleepinComputer
text: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 vulnerabilities, including 66 rated Critical and an actively exploited Microsoft Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) exploitable via malicious message files.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CISA KEV: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 pre-auth bypass chained w/ CVE-2026-111560 (OS RCE as root), CVSS 9.3. Chrome CVE-2026-125350 UAF RCE actively exploited.

author: CveTodo
text: Critical unauthenticated RCE in the WP Duplicate WordPress plugin is being actively exploited in the wild.

author: opsek_io
text: Chrome 157 security update: 9 vulnerabilities fixed incl. actively exploited zero-day CVE-2026-125350 (XML use-after-free), CVE-2026-125344 V8 type confusion, CVE-2026-125348 GPU OOB write.

author: ProferoSec
text: Google patched Chrome's eighth actively exploited zero-day of 2026, CVE-2026-125350, a use-after-free in the XML component. Update to 157.0.8103.50.

author: ProferoSec
text: Microsoft patched actively exploited Outlook zero-day CVE-2026-124194: crafted message file makes Outlook connect to attacker location without warning, leaking NTLMv2 hash.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CISA KEV Alert: 6 new actively exploited CVEs added Nov 10, 2026 incl. Cisco BroadWorks XXE, Barracuda.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-102895 in GPUStack (CVSS 9.8) is actively exploited: remote requests can impersonate the built-in administrator via a reverse proxy.

author: modularciso
text: CISA added GPUStack CVE-2026-102895 to KEV on Nov 9; vendor says observed exploited in the wild against a v2.1.1 deployment. Patching does not remove attacker persistence.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.2 CVE-2026-112136: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro MCP Server exposed beyond loopback; attacker with network access could interact remotely with the MCP Server.

author: securigeek
text: AWS patched CVE-2026-125271 in its API MCP Server: deny and approval rules can be bypassed by operation names with consecutive capitals. Upgrade aws-api-mcp-server to 1.5.1.

author: thepostapo
text: German web host Mittwald says an attacker exploited a vulnerability in its MCP server for AI assistants and compromised 56 client projects. It attributes the speed of the attack to AI tools.

author: modularciso
text: Visual Studio Copilot CVE-2026-103572: protected-file check misses '.mcp.json.' (trailing dot ignored by Windows), letting the agent write .mcp.json.

author: Khaled865412521
text: AG2 SandboxShellTool advisory GHSA-2h4w-29cv-2cmv (CVE-2026-113663, CVSS 8.8): allowed/readonly shell filter bypassed with a newline.

author: one_blues_fan
text: 30,000+ repositories targeted by GhostAction: compromised developer accounts, malicious CI/CD workflows, stolen credentials including AI API keys.

author: Sujeet
text: A supply-chain attack through malicious GitHub workflows compromised tens of thousands of repositories, including Uber-owned ones.

author: W3B_AI_SR
text: Supply chain attack targets Zcash, Vizor and Keplr developers: malicious PRs and a Rust crate lwd-uri-util that steals developer secrets during builds. Rotate secrets.

author: polydaic
text: Planted fake LLM API keys across GitHub, npm and PyPI to observe what bots do with stolen AI credentials.

author: cmani
text: Cybercriminals increasingly target cloud AI developer platforms to steal compute and API keys; hackers breached cloud-computing company Railway.

author: myldao
text: Railway published its full incident report: on Oct 20 attackers broke into its build system and could have decrypted customer env vars in up to 100,000 workspaces, running up about $740,000 in AI charges.

author: BigVikDada
text: Railway: attacker partially escaped build sandbox via unknown isolation bug, then a misconfigured OIDC binding gave a cloud credential, reaching the encrypted env-var production database.

author: csehra42
text: Railway's postmortem: the attacker wanted AI provider keys and searched variable names with regexes.

author: dailytechonx
text: Attackers used AI agents, build system flaws, and misconfigured cloud trust at Railway to steal API keys and run up ~$740,000 in unauthorized AI-service charges. Rotate secrets.

author: _soleysok
text: If you deployed on Railway before Oct 21, rotate your keys today; Railway posted the full postmortem for its October breach.

author: hackerlogs
text: Fireworks AI inference platform was breached by an LLMjacking crew; Notion says some Notion AI chat transcripts were in the stolen data.

author: Airdr0p360
text: NEAR AI confirmed a Nov 8 breach via an SGLang flaw: ~100 users' account details, 18 legacy AI agents and 2 Cloud API keys exposed.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed Claude Code silently writing cloud keys, DB passwords and SSH credentials into hidden config files later committed to public GitHub repos.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: X1Y1 checked 10,659 public MCP config files: two thirds of package-based servers are unpinned, so every agent restart runs unreviewed code.

author: _josehelps
text: Pillar Security (Eilon Cohen) found RCE in opencode on Windows and WSL through the remote MCP OAuth flow: connecting a coding agent to a malicious MCP server runs code before the model does anything, no prompt injection needed.

author: midkernel
text: Auth-bypass bugs in AI agent tooling: Dynatrace's MCP server accepted unauthenticated tool calls (CVE-2026-123811), and fast-agent served HTTP with no auth by default (CVE-2026-102610).

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: VulnCheck November update on Anthropic's Glasswing project: AI found 37,966 vulnerabilities in seven months, only 217 fixed. PHP2Shell (CVSS 9.2 unauthenticated RCE in the PHP engine) was its most notable find.

author: mitigata
text: Microsoft fixed 3 critical cloud flaws: Entra Device Registration (CVSS 10), Azure Managed Grafana and Azure OpenAI (both 9.8). Nothing to patch, but review access and rotate keys.

author: Pocno_x
text: Initia hit by second exploit in under 3 weeks: attacker used a compromised Google Cloud key, pivoted into GitHub and cloud accounts and validated fake IBC withdrawals from 5 rollups; ~$3.27M moved, ~$2.16M frozen.

author: endurasecurity
text: npm package @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0 was compromised with malware; GitHub says hosts that installed or ran it should be treated as fully compromised. Rebuild the host and rotate secrets from a clean machine.

author: Komodosec
text: Qubole supply chain attack exposed AWS, Entra ID, and Okta credentials: attackers used stolen credentials tied to Qubole's AWS account to enter customer AWS accounts via old cross-account trust roles (Wiz).

author: sukin_s
text: Apiiro scanned public GitHub for Claude Code's .claude/settings.local.json (Nov 1-3): 104,185 copies across 103,617 repos, 1,122 holding at least one secret such as database passwords saved via 'Yes, and don't ask again'.

author: lyrie_ai
text: SEGA confirmed on Nov 9 that 2,196,044 email addresses from 11 SEGA newsletters leaked through its third-party email distributor Arara; SEGA's own servers were not touched.
